newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: ARGENTINA'S FERNANDEZ SHUFFLES ECONOMIC TEAM.
newsitem.headline: ARGENTINA'S FERNANDEZ SHUFFLES ECONOMIC TEAM.

text.p: Argentine Economy Minister Roque Fernandez announced changes among senior members of his team Thursday, with his chief advisor Carlos Rodriguez taking on the additional role of economic planning secretary.
"Rodriguez will become economic planning secretary and keep his job as head of the cabinet of advisors of the ministry," Fernandez told reporters as he left a banking conference at the Central Bank.

Rodriguez takes over from Eugenio Pendas, who becomes Public Works Secretary -- a job vacated by Armando Guibert, the former public works and transport secretary who is leaving the ministry for "personal reasons," Fernandez said.
Guibert's old department is divided in two, with Armando Canosa becoming transport secretary. Canosa was previously the undersecretary of metropolitan and long distance transport.
